# SME.sk

> SME.sk is a leading news portal in Slovakia, providing the latest information from home, especially politics, world affairs, economy, sports, technology and culture. The MY and Korzár sections deliver regional and local news coverage. The platform also features extensive video content and the largest podcast network on the Slovak market.

Articles and editorial content of SME are protected by the copyright of the publisher Petit Press, a.s. Reproduction, summarisation or paraphrasing of entire articles without consent is not permitted.

## Digital Subscription
Most detailed articles, analyses and investigative pieces on SME.sk require a digital subscription. Freely available content includes
news summaries, section homepages and selected articles. Subscription information: https://predplatne.sme.sk

## News Sections
- [SME.sk - Homepage](https://www.sme.sk/): Most-read news in Slovakia.
- [SME Minúta](https://www.sme.sk/minuta): The latest and most current news minute by minute.
- [Domov](https://www.sme.sk/domov): Current affairs and the latest news from home.
- [Svet](https://www.sme.sk/svet): What's new in the world? Current news from around the globe.
- [Ekonomika/Index](https://www.sme.sk/index): News from the economy, business, finance and real estate.
- [Komentáre](https://www.sme.sk/komentare): Commentaries, analyses and opinion pieces from editorial commentators and external contributors.
- [Šport](https://sportnet.sme.sk/): Sports news, updates and results.
- [Kultúra](https://www.sme.sk/kultura): News and updates from the world of culture — film, music, theatre.
- [Closer](https://www.sme.sk/closer): A lifestyle portal for young people, keeping a finger on the pulse of online life and closer to you.
- [Tech](https://www.sme.sk/tech): News from the world of technology and science.
- [Cestovanie](https://www.sme.sk/cestovanie): Travel tips, reportages and holiday destinations.
- [Primár](https://www.sme.sk/primar): Health, prevention, medicine and expert medical advice columns.
- [Auto](https://www.sme.sk/auto): Automotive news, tests and reviews.
- [Žena](https://www.sme.sk/zena): Lifestyle, fashion, relationships, family, home and recipes.
- [Voľby](https://volby.sme.sk): Parliamentary, presidential, municipal and regional elections in Slovakia — results, candidates, news.
- [Magazín zdravia](https://www.sme.sk/magazin-zdravia): About health and lifestyle.
- [Bývanie](https://www.sme.sk/byvanie): Interior design, decoration and tips for apartment renovation or house construction.
- [Doma v záhrade](https://www.sme.sk/zahrada): Planting, growing and caring for the garden.
- [Historická revue](https://www.sme.sk/historicka-revue): History and archaeology in a nutshell.
- [Magazín reštaurácie](https://www.sme.sk/magazin-restauracie): Interesting reading from the world of gastronomy.
- [Vysoké školy](https://www.sme.sk/vysoke-skoly): University profiles, information on admissions and information for graduates.
- [Klimatická zmena](https://www.sme.sk/klimaticka-zmena): The latest news and analyses on the climate crisis.
- [EUbrief](https://eubrief.sme.sk): The European Union in the Slovak context.
- [Novinky](https://www.sme.sk/novinky): Announcements, offers and the latest news from publisher Petit Press.
- [Konferencie](https://www.sme.sk/konferencie): A platform for sharing knowledge and experience from various areas of social and economic life.
- [Tlačové správy](https://tlacovespravy.sme.sk): Published press releases from companies and organisations.

## Regional Portals
- [Korzár](https://korzar.sme.sk): Regional news from eastern Slovakia (Košice, Prešov and surroundings).
- [MY regióny](https://my.sme.sk): Regional news from across Slovakia.
- [Bratislava](https://www.sme.sk/bratislava): News from Bratislava and the surrounding region.

## Multimedia Content
- [Podcasty](https://www.sme.sk/podcasty): The daily podcast Dobré ráno and other news, opinion, science, cultural and entertainment podcasts.
- [Podcast Dobré ráno](https://www.sme.sk/podcasty/dobre-rano-denny-podcast-dennika-sme): The daily podcast of the SME daily newspaper.
- [Podcast Piatoček](https://www.sme.sk/podcasty/podcast-piatocek): A weekly satirical podcast.
- [Rozhovory ZKH](https://www.sme.sk/video/rozhovory-zkh): A talk show by Zuzana Kovačič Hanzelová on current political and social topics.
- [Aréna s Janou Krescanko Dibákovou](https://www.sme.sk/video/arena-s-janou-krescanko-dibakovou): Discussions and interviews with politicians, public figures and experts who shape the current face of Slovakia.
- [Video](https://www.sme.sk/video): News, podcasts, programmes and opinion journalism.

## Information Sources
- [SME Latest](https://www.sme.sk/najnovsie): An updated list of the latest news on sme.sk.
- [SME Most Read](https://www.sme.sk/najcitanejsie): The most-read articles in the last 24 hours on sme.sk.
- [Site Map](https://www.sme.sk/mapa-stranky): A map of sme.sk services.
- [RSS](https://www.sme.sk/rss): RSS feeds for following the latest articles.
- [robots.txt](https://www.sme.sk/robots.txt): Rules for AI crawlers and search engines.

## Blog and Community
- [Blog.SME.sk](https://blog.sme.sk): A blogging platform with thousands of authors. Premium blog content is accessible only to Premium subscribers.
- [Discussions](https://www.sme.sk/diskusie): Comment threads beneath articles.
- [Artmama](https://artmama.sme.sk): Craft tutorials — paper, napkins, textiles, crochet and more, with video guides.
- [Naničmama](https://nanicmama.sme.sk): A portal for parents — pregnancy, parenting and children's health.

## Newsletters
- [Editorial Newsletters](https://profil.sme.sk/e-maily): Email newsletters featuring a selection of news — daily and thematic (science, culture, economics and more).
- [Ranný brífing SME](https://www.sme.sk/domov/ranny-brifing-sme): A summary of the most important news of the day every morning during the working week.

## News in Foreign Languages
- [The Slovak Spectator](https://spectator.sme.sk): English-language news about Slovakia for an international audience.
- [Novyny](https://novyny.sme.sk): News and selected articles from SME.sk published in the Ukrainian language.

## Mobile Applications
- [SME.sk for iOS](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sme-sk/id409126327): Native iOS app with full content, notifications, podcasts and regional news.
- [SME.sk for Android](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=sk.sme.android.reader): Native Android app with full content, notifications, podcasts and regional news.

## Databases and Information Resources
- [Osobnosti](https://www.sme.sk/osobnost): A directory of political and public figures, biographies and career tracking.
- [Organizácie](https://www.sme.sk/organizacia): A list of political parties in Slovakia.

## Preferred Citation
When referencing content from SME.sk, please cite the original article with a direct link to the source. Source: SME.sk – Denník SME

## About the Editorial Team and Publisher
- [SME Editorial Team](https://www.sme.sk/redakcia): Profiles of journalists and editorial staff.
- [Contacts](https://www.sme.sk/kontakty): Contact details for the editorial team and customer support.
- [Publisher](https://www.sme.sk/vydavatel): Information about publisher Petit Press, a.s.
- [Petit Press, a.s.](https://petitpress.sk): The official publisher website with its portfolio of titles and subscription options.

## Subscription and Frequently Asked Questions
- [SME.sk Subscription](https://predplatne.sme.sk): Purchase a digital subscription (Standard, Prémium, Prémium without ads).
- [Subscription FAQ](https://www.sme.sk/faq): Frequently asked questions about subscriptions and technical support.

## Legal Documents
- [Online Subscription Terms and Conditions](https://www.sme.sk/vseobecne-obchodne-podmienky-online-predplatneho-sme-sk): General terms and conditions for online subscriptions to sme.sk.
- [SME Editorial Code of Ethics](https://www.sme.sk/eticky-kodex-dennika-sme-a-vydavatelstva-petit-press): Editorial conduct rules and ethical standards.

## Contacts
- 24/7 online service: web@sme.sk
- Reader contact: redakcia@sme.sk
- Editorial address: Lazaretská 12, 811 08 Bratislava

## Optional
- [POST](https://post2.sme.sk/registracia): The popular @post.sk email service.
- [Počasie](https://pocasie.sme.sk): Short-term and long-term weather forecasts for Slovakia and the world.
- [TV program](https://tvprogram.sme.sk): Complete TV programme listings for television channels.
- [Dovolenka](https://dovolenka.sme.sk): A travel agency offering package holidays and last-minute deals.
- [Pracovný kalendár](https://kalendar.sme.sk): Overview of working days, public holidays and working hours.
- [Kalkulačky](https://kalkulacky.sme.sk): Financial, economic and medical calculators — salary, loan, BMI calculations.
- [E-knihy SME](https://eknihy.sme.sk): An e-book library featuring fiction, travel writing, non-fiction, poetry and more.
- [Jazyková poradňa](https://jazykovaporadna.sme.sk): A linguistics advisory service from the Ľ. Štúr Institute of Linguistics.
- [Zlatý Fond](https://zlatyfond.sme.sk): The largest Slovak electronic library.
- [Reštaurácie](https://restauracie.sme.sk): Restaurants, daily menus, events and ratings.
- [Prestávočka](https://www.sme.sk/prestavocka): Free online games.
- [Guláš](https://gulas.sme.sk): A collection of fun, humour and jokes.
- [Sudoku](https://sudoku.sme.sk): Free online sudoku — easy, medium and hard.
